headline: A 2015 federal law names a 10-mile stretch of Interstate 10 in Kendall County, Texas, after Medal of Honor recipient PFC Milton A. Lee.
what_it_does: The law renames the part of Interstate Route 10 between mileposts 535 and 545 in Kendall County, Texas, as the "PFC Milton A. Lee Medal of Honor Memorial Highway." It is an honorary designation that changes the highway's name but does not change its route, lanes, or traffic rules. The official summary does not describe any other requirements or funding.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on August 7, 2015.
